name: v0.3.30 — new launcher icon: GetGuac mascot (no more wizard hat)
releaseNotes:
• Android launcher icon replaced with the GetGuac brand mascot — friendly avocado on the GuacGreen→lime gradient. The old wizard-hat avocado (from an earlier brand draft) is retired.
• Generated via the existing mascot SVG (happy.svg) rendered through headless Chrome, then run through flutter_launcher_icons to produce all five Android density buckets + the adaptive-icon foreground/background pair.
